Upper Text: When this card would be played, if there are 12 or more levels' total worth of Digimon, reduce the cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [TS] trait Digimon card with 6000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any Digimon are played or digivolve, you may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, if played or digivolved by an effect, delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon.
